context.instruction: 任务 dual_arm_coordination_batch01：按 task_policy.visit_order 完成两个占位阶段，每只机械臂的 TCP 在其给定目标连续保持至少 0.5 秒。终态第二只臂保持其目标，第一只臂回到本回合初始 Ready TCP，连续保持 2 秒。双夹爪全程打开，不抓物；不得互臂接触或发生非预期机械臂/桌面接触。自主决定数值目标和顺序/并行关系。仅输出给定 JSON schema。done=true 仅表示停止，随后保持驱动目标观察 2 秒，不代表成功。

conventions.quaternion: unit quaternion [w,x,y,z], Link6 orientation in world
conventions.tcp: mean of the actual two inner pad face centres; offset depends on measured gripper configuration
conventions.opening_fraction: 0 closed command, 1 open command; measured gap is actual_pad_gap_m, not this command
conventions.execution: one tcp OR gripper operation per named arm. sequential follows list order. parallel overlaps both operations in shared physics steps. Omitted arm holds drive targets. No automatic obstacle rerouting or target correction.
conventions.time: physics paused during inference; execution advances physics. Not real-time asynchronous control. Every successful numeric group ends with 0.5 s of physical observation holding its final drive targets; sequential groups each get this hold, parallel groups share it. done=true or the decision limit ends with a 2 s passive terminal hold. No expert movement is inserted.
